blogPosts.title: How Much Does an Electrician Cost in Bentleigh in 2026?
blogPosts.excerpt: A complete guide to electrician pricing in Bentleigh — from call-out fees to full rewiring costs for south-east Melbourne homeowners.
body: If you are a Bentleigh homeowner wondering how much an electrician costs in 2026, you are not alone. Electrical pricing can vary significantly depending on the type of job, the complexity of the wiring, and whether you need materials supplied. At Expert Wiring, we believe in complete transparency, so this guide breaks down typical electrical costs across Bentleigh and Melbourne's south-east so you can budget with confidence.

For standard residential call-outs in Bentleigh, most licensed electricians charge between $80 and $150 for the initial visit. This typically covers travel, diagnosis, and a written quote for any further work. At Expert Wiring, our call-out fee includes a thorough on-site assessment so David can provide an accurate, fixed quote before any work begins. There is never any obligation to proceed, and you will know exactly what you are paying before a single wire is touched.

Installing new power points is one of the most common requests from Bentleigh homeowners, particularly in older homes where power points are scarce. Expect to pay between $80 and $150 per power point installed, depending on whether you need a new circuit run from the switchboard or if an existing circuit can be extended. Switchboard upgrades, which are increasingly recommended for older Bentleigh properties to meet current Australian standards, typically range from $800 to $2,000 depending on the size of the board and the number of circuits required.

Lighting upgrades are another popular project in Bentleigh, especially as more homeowners switch to energy-efficient LED downlights. Installing LED downlights typically costs between $60 and $120 per light, including the fitting and labour. A full lighting upgrade for a standard three-bedroom Bentleigh home might cost between $1,500 and $3,500 depending on the number of lights, dimmer switches, and any smart lighting controls you want installed. David from Expert Wiring can advise on the best lighting layout for your home to maximise both style and energy savings.

More complex electrical work such as NBN cabling, security camera installation, or oven and cooktop wiring will naturally cost more due to the materials and time involved. NBN cabling in a Bentleigh home typically ranges from $300 to $800 depending on the number of data points and cable runs required. CCTV camera installations start from around $500 for a basic two-camera setup and can exceed $3,000 for comprehensive multi-camera systems with recording equipment. Oven installations generally cost between $150 and $350, and David always issues a Certificate of Electrical Safety with every appliance installation.

When choosing an electrician in Bentleigh, always ensure they hold a current Victorian electrical licence and can provide a Certificate of Electrical Safety upon completion of the work. The cheapest quote is not always the best value — poor workmanship can lead to safety hazards, failed inspections, and costly repairs down the track. At Expert Wiring, David has over 10 years of experience serving the Bentleigh community and takes pride in using quality materials and delivering neat, lasting electrical work that meets all Australian standards.

blogPosts.title: Signs Your Bentleigh Home Needs a Switchboard Upgrade
blogPosts.excerpt: Learn the key warning signs that your Bentleigh property's switchboard is outdated and may need upgrading to meet current Australian safety standards.
body: Your switchboard is the heart of your home's electrical system, safely distributing power to every circuit in your Bentleigh property. If your home was built before the mid-1990s, there is a good chance your switchboard may be outdated and potentially unsafe. At Expert Wiring, David regularly inspects and upgrades switchboards across Bentleigh, McKinnon, and surrounding suburbs, helping homeowners stay safe and compliant with current Australian electrical standards.

One of the clearest signs you need a switchboard upgrade is if your board still uses ceramic fuses rather than modern circuit breakers or safety switches. Ceramic fuses offer very limited protection compared to today's standards — they do not trip quickly enough during a fault, which increases the risk of electrical fires and electric shock. Australian regulations now require safety switches, also known as residual current devices or RCDs, on all power and lighting circuits in residential properties. If your Bentleigh home does not have RCDs, an upgrade should be a priority.

Frequent circuit breaker trips are another telling sign that your switchboard is struggling to cope. If you find that your power keeps cutting out when you run the kettle, microwave, and washing machine at the same time, your switchboard may be overloaded or your circuits may need to be redistributed. Older Bentleigh homes often have insufficient circuits for modern electrical demands, leading to constant tripping that is both frustrating and a potential fire risk. David can assess your switchboard and recommend the right solution.

Visible damage, burning marks, or a buzzing sound coming from your switchboard are serious warning signs that should never be ignored. These symptoms indicate dangerous electrical faults that require immediate attention from a licensed electrician. If you notice any of these signs at your Bentleigh property, call Expert Wiring on 0417 119 177 straight away. Electrical fires caused by faulty switchboards are entirely preventable with proper maintenance and timely upgrades.

Bentleigh homeowners planning renovations should also consider a switchboard upgrade as part of their project. Adding new circuits for air conditioning, solar panels, electric vehicle chargers, or additional power points often exceeds the capacity of older switchboards. Upgrading your switchboard during a renovation is more cost-effective than doing it as a separate job later, and it ensures your entire electrical system can safely handle increased demand for years to come.

David from Expert Wiring has upgraded hundreds of switchboards across Bentleigh and Melbourne's south-east over the past decade. Every upgrade is completed to current Australian standards, and David always provides a Certificate of Electrical Safety upon completion. If you are unsure whether your switchboard needs attention, book a free assessment with Expert Wiring — it could be the most important call you make for your home's safety.

blogPosts.title: NBN Cabling Solutions for Bentleigh Homes and Offices
blogPosts.excerpt: Struggling with slow internet in Bentleigh? Discover how professional NBN cabling can transform your home or business connectivity.
body: If your internet speed in Bentleigh does not match what your NBN plan promises, the problem may not be with your internet provider — it could be your home cabling. Many Bentleigh properties, particularly older homes, have outdated or poorly installed internal cabling that creates bottlenecks, signal loss, and unreliable connections. At Expert Wiring, David specialises in NBN cabling solutions that ensure you get every bit of speed your plan offers.

The most common NBN cabling issue David encounters in Bentleigh homes is poorly run or damaged internal wiring between the NBN connection point and the modem location. In many older homes, telephone cabling was originally installed for ADSL and is not suitable for the higher frequencies used by NBN services. This old cabling can cause significant speed reductions, dropouts, and intermittent connection issues. Upgrading to quality Cat6 or Cat6a ethernet cabling ensures your data travels cleanly from the wall socket to your router.

Professional NBN cabling installation in Bentleigh typically involves running new ethernet cables from the NBN termination point to strategic locations throughout your home or office. This allows you to connect your modem via ethernet rather than relying on Wi-Fi for the primary connection, which dramatically improves speed and reliability. For larger Bentleigh homes, David recommends installing data points in the living area, home office, and bedrooms to ensure every room has access to fast, stable internet.

Bentleigh businesses also benefit enormously from proper NBN cabling. If you run a home office, a retail shop, or a small commercial operation, reliable internet is non-negotiable. David from Expert Wiring has cabled numerous Bentleigh offices and commercial spaces, running structured data cabling systems that support VoIP phones, security cameras, point-of-sale systems, and multiple workstations simultaneously without any loss of performance.

What sets Expert Wiring apart from other NBN cabling providers in Bentleigh is David's commitment to neat, organised work. Cabling is routed discreetly through walls, ceilings, and roof spaces, with clean terminations at every data point. David also tests every connection with professional-grade equipment to verify that the cabling meets or exceeds NBN speed requirements before he leaves the job. Many Bentleigh customers have reported dramatic improvements in their internet speed after Expert Wiring upgraded their internal cabling.

If you are experiencing slow or unreliable internet at your Bentleigh property, do not assume the fault lies with your NBN provider. Book an assessment with Expert Wiring on 0417 119 177, and David will inspect your existing cabling and recommend the most cost-effective solution. In many cases, a relatively modest investment in new cabling can deliver a transformation in your internet experience that far exceeds what any plan upgrade could achieve.

blogPosts.title: CCTV Security Camera Installation Guide for Bentleigh Properties
blogPosts.excerpt: Protect your Bentleigh home with professionally installed CCTV cameras — a complete guide to camera types, placement, and costs.
body: Security is a top priority for Bentleigh homeowners, and professionally installed CCTV cameras are one of the most effective ways to protect your property, deter criminals, and gain peace of mind. At Expert Wiring, David has installed hundreds of CCTV systems across Bentleigh, McKinnon, Carnegie, and surrounding suburbs, tailoring each setup to the specific layout and security needs of the property. This guide covers everything you need to know about CCTV installation in Bentleigh.

Modern CCTV cameras come in a wide range of types, and choosing the right combination for your Bentleigh property depends on what you want to monitor. Bullet cameras are ideal for covering driveways, front yards, and long narrow spaces, while dome cameras provide a wider field of view suited to patios, backyards, and entry points. Pan-tilt-zoom cameras offer the most flexibility, allowing you to remotely control the camera angle and zoom in on specific areas. David from Expert Wiring will assess your Bentleigh property and recommend the camera types that best suit your security requirements.

Camera placement is critical to getting effective coverage of your Bentleigh property. The front door is the most important location, as it provides identification of anyone approaching your home. Driveway cameras capture vehicle details and monitor activity at the street, while backyard cameras protect the often-overlooked rear of the property where intruders typically attempt entry. David strategically positions each camera to maximise coverage while minimising blind spots, ensuring your Bentleigh home has comprehensive security from every angle.

The cost of CCTV installation in Bentleigh varies depending on the number of cameras, the type of cameras selected, and the complexity of the cabling required. A basic two-camera system for a Bentleigh home typically starts from around $500, while a comprehensive four-to-eight camera system with a recording device and remote viewing capability ranges from $1,500 to $4,000. Premium systems with 4K resolution, night vision, and motion-activated recording commands a higher price but deliver superior image quality and more reliable evidence in the event of an incident.

Professional installation by a licensed electrician like David ensures your CCTV system is wired safely and complies with all Australian electrical standards. Poorly installed security cameras are not only ineffective — they can create electrical hazards and may not hold up as evidence if ever needed. David runs all cabling through walls, ceilings, and roof spaces for a neat, discreet finish that does not detract from your Bentleigh home's appearance. Every installation includes a Certificate of Electrical Safety and a full demonstration of the system so you know exactly how to use it.

Bentleigh homeowners considering CCTV installation should act before an incident occurs rather than after. The peace of mind that comes from knowing your property is monitored around the clock is invaluable, and modern systems allow you to view live footage from your smartphone no matter where you are. Contact Expert Wiring on 0417 119 177 to arrange a free on-site security assessment at your Bentleigh property. David will assess your property, discuss your concerns, and provide a detailed, fixed-price quote for a CCTV system tailored to your home.
